_readme: Golden regression cases for --mode news (news coverage). Verifies peer-review is off and that domain tier + engagement dominate, since the recency signal only applies to URLs carrying a scholar record (rare for news pages). The cases are ordered as the mode's tier ladder, so a regression that flattens it shows up as an ordering change and not just a score change: the instrument itself (tier 1) > original reporting (tier 2) > re-report and analysis (tier 3) > general and technology trade media (tier 4) > unregistered (tier 5). Both tier-2 and tier-3 cases are present because the mode raises the tier-3 base to 66 specifically to give re-report a band to land in; if that regressed to the base table's 60 the law-firm case would silently drop to WEAK. Run with `python3 scripts/check_policy.py`; re-baseline with `--bless` after a deliberate policy change.

cases.name: wire-service report is original reporting, not supporting material
law-firm client alert re-reports a regulator, and has a band to land in
policy institute commentary is analysis, not reporting
unregistered outlet falls to default tier
listicle path penalty on a general media site
